title: What to take at a hotel buffet when you want to lose weight
intro: A hotel buffet is full of temptation. There's sushi, kambing golek, pastries and a flowing chocolate fountain. You can enjoy it all without feeling like you 'wasted money'. The key is a round strategy and plate size. The calorie numbers below are estimates only.

best.name: Salad bar with olive oil or lime dressing (1 plate)
best.why: Start with vegetables. Your stomach fills up and you're less rushed to grab heavy dishes.

best.name: Grilled fish or chicken (1 medium piece)
best.why: High protein and not fried. The best choice in the mains section.

best.name: Roast meat from the carving station (3 thin slices)
best.why: Solid protein. Ask for a little sauce or have it on the side.

best.name: Vegetable soup or clear soup (1 bowl)
best.why: Warm and filling. Choose clear soup, not creamy ones.

best.name: Stir-fried or steamed vegetables (1 big scoop)
best.why: Adds fibre and volume to your plate with low calories.

best.name: Fresh fruit (1 small plate)
best.why: A naturally sweet dessert. Great to finish with after a little dessert.

careful.name: Pastries and mini cakes (3 pieces)
careful.why: Small in size, but lots of butter and sugar. Pick the 1 or 2 that look best.

careful.name: Cream of mushroom soup (1 bowl)
careful.why: Cream and butter push the calories up. Swap for clear soup.

careful.name: Fried food: tempura, fries, nuggets (1 small plate)
careful.why: Easy to take a lot because they're small. Take a little just for the taste.

careful.name: Pasta carbonara (1 plate)
careful.why: Cream and cheese sauce. If you want pasta, choose tomato sauce and take half.

careful.name: Nasi beriani kambing (1 plate)
careful.why: Oily rice and fatty mutton. Take just 2 spoons of rice and one piece of meat.

hacks: Do one 'survey' round first without a plate. Pick what you really want to eat.
Use a small plate or dessert plate for your mains.
First round: salad, clear soup and protein. Second round, then your favourites.
Sit a bit further from the buffet table so it's not so easy to keep getting up.
For dessert, take 2 types and share. Taste everything without feeling too full.
drink: Plain water or hot tea without sugar. If you want juice, have just one small glass.

faq.q: I paid a lot, it feels like a waste if I eat a little. What do I do?
faq.a: You're paying for the experience and the choices, not to eat until your stomach hurts. Pick items you rarely get at home, like seafood or roast meat, and enjoy them slowly.

faq.q: Should I fast before going to a buffet?
faq.a: Not recommended. If you're too hungry, you tend to eat more. Eat as usual earlier in the day, just lighter and higher in protein.
